input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets or exceeds our preferred position: 19.1 gives a professional and workmanlike services warranty plus material conformity to documentation; 19.2 gives a 90-day Deliverable conformity warranty and conformity of hosted Services for the whole subscription term (better than the 12-month software benchmark); 19.3 adds no-malicious-code and compliance-with-law warranties; 19.4 provides the repair/re-perform/replace remedy with termination and refund of Fees paid if Vendor cannot cure, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, IP, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The disclaimer in 19.5 is limited to implied warranties and expressly states that no disclaimer limits an express warranty, so it does not swallow the express warranties. No redline needed.
